scope: Current public source distribution and reachable GitHub refs/history. Vendor document permissions remain publisher-specific, but those bytes are excluded. This record does not certify third-party rights or GitHub server-side deletion of unreachable cached objects.

findings.reason: 32 vendor PDFs have no established general redistribution grant; permission or exclusion from a public distribution is required.
findings.resolution: All vendor PDFs and document-rich screenshots are excluded from the source distribution. Prose citations were replaced with short factual technical/API/register anchors. Only original ChipSim implementation, functional facts, metadata and properly licensed upstream software remain. Private source verification keeps original hashes and page checks.

findings.reason: Vendor PDF blobs exist in Git history; exact refs/archive to publish must be reviewed or sanitized. A current-tree deletion or .gitignore alone does not remove earlier blobs.
findings.resolution: All reachable commits were rewritten to exclude every historical PDF, prior screenshot PNG and captured frame file, and identified long vendor-prose citations. The filtered object graph was inspected for forbidden paths, PDF signatures and replaced phrases. Four original PIO teaching captures were then restored. Only sanitized main is published; original backup refs are not uploaded. Unreachable GitHub caches are outside this resolution.
